remediation.issue: Connector examples direct agents to execute local Python scripts with user-supplied query and domain values.
remediation.suggestion: Require user confirmation, validate all placeholders, and invoke scripts with structured arguments instead of interpolated shell commands.

content.user_title: Analyze Backlinks and AI Referral Traffic
content.value_statement: Backlink and AI referral data often live in separate tools and produce inconsistent conclusions. This skill creates source-labeled analyses with trends, risks, comparisons, and prioritized actions.
actual_capabilities: Profiles referring domains, authority distribution, anchor mix, link velocity, and toxic-link share from supplied backlink data.
Scores individual links with a documented quality rubric and identifies disavow candidates for manual review.
Compares competitor backlink exports to identify intersections, content gaps, and prioritized outreach prospects.
Isolates AI-assistant referrals in GA4 exports or server logs and compares them with organic traffic.
Produces source-labeled reports, trend summaries, landing-page analysis, and reusable handoff notes.
limitations: Backlink counts require a user export or connected link database.
AI referral metrics require GA4, Search Console, or server-log data.
Referral traffic proves a click, not citation prominence inside an AI answer.
Disavow recommendations require manual verification before submission.

use_cases.title: Audit a Backlink Profile
use_cases.description: Review referring domains, anchors, authority, toxicity, and link changes from an exported backlink dataset.

use_cases.title: Measure AI Referral Performance
use_cases.description: Compare AI-assistant sessions, landing pages, engagement, and conversion with organic traffic for the same period.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Link Opportunities
use_cases.description: Compare competitor exports and rank outreach prospects by overlap, relevance, authority, effort, and expected impact.

prompt_templates.title: Review My Backlinks
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this backlink CSV for example.com. Use backlinks mode and label every metric by source.

prompt_templates.title: Measure AI Referrals
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ai-referrals mode on this GA4 export. Compare AI sessions, landing pages, and conversion with organic for the same period.

prompt_templates.title: Find Competitor Link Gaps
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare my backlink export with these three competitor exports. Rank prospects by overlap, authority, relevance, effort, and impact.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Controlled AI Trend
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze four AI-referral periods, apply the provided control baseline, flag sample-size limits, and produce a handoff summary with evidence.

output_examples.input: Backlink export for example.com with authority, anchor, target, and first-seen columns.
output: Profile health: moderate, based on a concentrated anchor mix and uneven authority distribution.
Toxic-link share: 7 percent, marked User-provided and requiring manual review.
Priority actions: diversify anchors, reclaim two lost editorial links, and review six disavow candidates.

output_examples.input: GA4 source and medium export with sessions, landing pages, conversions, and organic comparison data.
output: AI referrals increased 18 percent during the selected period.
ChatGPT produced the most sessions, while Perplexity produced the highest conversion rate.
The sample remains small, so the result is labeled Keep-testing.

best_practices: Provide exports covering the same date window for valid comparisons.
Keep backlinks and AI referrals in separate modes and reports.
Verify toxic links manually before recommending removal or disavowal.
anti_patterns: Do not estimate backlink volume without a link dataset.
Do not present AI referral clicks as proof of citation prominence.
Do not upload a disavow file without evidence, backup, and review.

faq.question: What data does backlinks mode require?
faq.answer: Provide a backlink or referring-domain export. Anchor, authority, target, and date fields improve the analysis.

faq.question: What data does ai-referrals mode require?
faq.answer: Provide GA4 source data, Search Console data, server logs, or a connected analytics source.

faq.question: Can the skill analyze both modes together?
faq.answer: It keeps the modes separate because they use different evidence. Run one mode first, then request the other.

faq.question: Does AI referral traffic prove an AI citation?
faq.answer: No. It proves a referral click from an observed source, but not citation position or prominence.

faq.question: Will the skill create a disavow file?
faq.answer: It can prepare candidates and formatting guidance. Manual review is required before any Search Console submission.

faq.question: Does the skill save results automatically?
faq.answer: No. It asks for permission before writing a monitoring summary to memory.
